verdict.rationale: Baseten has a first-party coding-agents guide for connecting Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Pi to Model APIs via Baseten Switch, and an agent-setup page with an official skill and MCP servers. Its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints back these integrations. Agent-framework coverage is thin: the only framework example is LangChain's ChatOpenAI pointed at Baseten's base_url, inside the structured-outputs page. Missing for 10: dedicated integration guides for agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) beyond a single snippet, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the coding-agent integrations.
